mapper.select: SELECT id, outcome, computed_tomography_code AS chestXRayCode FROM tb_screen_computed_tomography WHERE person_id = #{personId} ORDER BY screen_time DESC LiMIT 1
SELECT remark, outcome FROM `tb_screen_chest_radiograph` WHERE person_id = 21 AND screen_order = 1 LIMIT 1
select screen_order,screen_time,outcome from tb_screen_computed_tomography where person_id=#{personId} and screen_type=#{screenType} and `year`=#{year} order by screen_order
SELECT ifnull(count(DISTINCT person_id),0) num FROM tb_screen_computed_tomography WHERE YEAR(screen_time) = #{year} and screen_type=#{screenType}
SELECT ifnull(count(DISTINCT person_id),0) num FROM tb_screen_computed_tomography WHERE YEAR(screen_time) = #{year} and MONTH(screen_time)=#{month} and screen_type=#{screenType}
SELECT ifnull(count(DISTINCT person_id),0) num FROM tb_screen_computed_tomography WHERE DATE (screen_time) = #{curDay} and screen_type=#{screenType}
select outcome from tb_screen_computed_tomography where screen_type=#{screenType} and screen_order=#{screenOrder} and id_num=#{idNum} and year=#{year}
